functions.name: private.can_write_shared_daily
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_write_shared_daily(cid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select private.is_admin() or (private.can_access_client(cid) and exists(select 1 from public.clients c where c.id=cid and (c.work_mode='Solo' or exists(select 1 from public.team_members m where m.client_id=cid and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.team_role='Responsable'))));
$function$

functions.name: private.can_write_team_report
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_write_team_report(cid uuid, mid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select private.is_admin() or (private.can_access_client(cid) and exists(select 1 from public.team_members m join public.clients c on c.id=m.client_id where m.id=mid and m.client_id=cid and m.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and c.work_mode='Équipe'));
$function$

functions.name: private.keep_team_report_identity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.keep_team_report_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.client_id<>old.client_id or new.member_id<>old.member_id or new.report_date<>old.report_date then raise exception 'Le dossier, la personne et la journée ne peuvent pas être déplacés'; end if;
 return new;
end; $function$
